name: How do I choose the right location for a primary bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right location for a primary bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right location for a primary bathroom addition involves considering existing plumbing lines, access to exterior walls for ventilation, and how the new bathroom will integrate with your home's overall layout. Placing it near existing plumbing can reduce costs and complexity. A key decision factor is balancing convenience and privacy with structural feasibility and budget. For instance, converting unused space like a large closet or expanding an existing room might be more straightforward than building an entirely new extension.
